inputs.text: One of the three inputs into the gate whose output is J: taking any one of them high takes that output to 10V.
One of the three inputs into the gate whose output is K: taking any one of them high takes that output to 10V.
One of the three inputs into the gate whose output is L: taking any one of them high takes that output to 10V.

outputs.text: 10V while any of A, B and C is high, 0V while they are all low.
10V while any of D, E and F is high, 0V while they are all low.
10V while any of G, H and I is high, 0V while they are all low.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
